thresholds.source: validation split only; thresholds frozen before holdout evaluation
thresholds.score_selection: best validation AUROC among three predeclared outputs; then validation F1 threshold; no holdout used

latency_scope: 66 held-out individual images after five warm-ups; CPU two threads; 192x192. Includes resize/normalization, neural inference and thresholding; excludes network, image-file read, camera, controller and robot, and PNG UI encoding.
limitations: Custom supervised split, not official unsupervised MVTec benchmark
No exact image hash overlap; independent production batch metadata unavailable
Single public product category; not a validation of actual factory equipment
Scores are not calibrated probabilities; errors are all retained
